title: IT Support & Google Workspace Administrator
description:
IT Support & Google Workspace Administrator 
 Role Overview We are looking for a hands-on IT professional responsible for end-user support, endpoint management, Google Workspace administration, security and basic cloud support . The candidate should be able to handle high-volume support requests, troubleshoot issues independently and work within defined SLAs. Key Responsibilities 
 Provide hands-on support for Windows laptops/desktops, hardware, applications and peripherals . Install, configure, troubleshoot and maintain endpoint devices. Administer Google Workspace , including user accounts, Groups, Gmail, Drive, DLP, Security Center and Vault. Manage Google Endpoint Management for Windows, macOS and ChromeOS. Manage user lifecycle, IAM, SSO, MFA and access controls . Support Active Directory, VPN, networking and basic server-related issues . Provide basic administration/support for GCP , including IAM, Compute Engine, VPC and Cloud Storage. Manage IT assets and support employee onboarding/offboarding . Monitor logs, troubleshoot security issues and support security/compliance requirements. Maintain IT documentation and provide evidence for ISO audits and compliance . Automate routine tasks using scripts/tools where required. Manage incidents and requests through Jira and meet defined SLAs. Participate in on-call support and handle critical IT issues when required. 
 Required Skills 
 Windows OS Strong hands-on experience (Mandatory) Hardware/PC Support – Strong hands-on experience (Mandatory) Google Workspace Administration Google Workspace DLP, Security Center & Vault Google Endpoint Management Active Directory, VPN, SSO & MFA Strong communication skills for interacting with US users. Basic GCP knowledge – IAM, Compute, VPC & Storage Basic Linux, macOS and Networking knowledge Familiarity with MDM/UEM and scripting/automation Good troubleshooting, communication and stakeholder-management skills Experience with Jira or similar ITSM tools Understanding of security, ISO and compliance requirements 
 Note: Shift: 6:00 PM – 3:00 AM, Monday–Friday

Key Skills: G Suite,VPN,IT support,SSO,VPN configuration,Security,Administration,System
